xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" status="edited" xml:id="ex2012023-07-10082928" ana="corpusmd:colophon"><milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (22a1–22a2)"/><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4449"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3692">bcom ldan 'das yum brgyad stong pa</rs>'i don bsdus pa</rs> <lb n="22a2"/> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3712">slob dpon seng ge bzang po</rs>'i rjes su 'brangs te | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">lo tsha ba chen po dge slong blo ldan shes rab</rs> kyis gzhan la phan par bya ba'i phyir sbyar ba las | dus phyis <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5611">jo bo 'bum pa</rs> dang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786">lo tsha ba</rs> de nyid kyi rjes su 'brang zhing <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3807">mang du thos pa'i dge slong shes rab 'bar</rs> gyis mdo'i don legs par gtan la phab nas yang zhus te sbyar ba || || rdzogs s+ho || ||</seg></TEI>
